the use of instructional strategies to enhance relevance can be beneficial in the context of EFL instruction, especially when used in conjunction with a high level of intrinsic motivation.

the inclusion of instructional strategies designed to enhance the perceived relevance of a CBIM program can facilitate EFL students’ comprehension regardless of their level of intrinsic motivation.
